data.action: 停在高窗边，双手持平板低头核对日程。
data.description: 【四宫宅走廊·清晨】早坂爱穿着整洁的黑白女仆装停在高窗旁，双手稳稳持着平板核对日程。侧马尾落在肩后，表情克制而专注；晨光在木地板上排成长条，远处走廊仍然安静。
data.promptProse: Ai Hayasaka stops beside the Shinomiya mansion's tall window, holding a tablet steadily in both hands to review the day's schedule. Her long-sleeved black maid dress, modest white apron and blonde side ponytail remain composed. The medium environmental portrait follows the quiet wood-floored corridor beyond her. Morning sunlight falls in long rectangular strips across the boards, illuminating her apron and tablet rim while the distant doorway stays in softer shade.
data.title: 早坂爱 · 清晨四宫宅的女仆晨检
